next.reason: 1985: "If the RECORD clause is not specified, the size of each data record is completely defined in the record description entry."; 2023: "an implicit format 1 or format 2 RECORD clause is assumed ... defined by the implementor ... integer-1 shall be the record size of the largest". 1985 takes each record's size from its own description. 2023 assumes an implementor-chosen format 1 (each record the size of the largest) or format 2 (variable, min/max bounds).
